# GORISCV64 optional extensions must be forwarded to the assembler as
# GORISCV64EXT_* defines, in addition to the profile define.

env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=riscv64
env GORISCV64=rva23u64,zacas,misaligned_fast
go build -x .
stderr '-D GORISCV64_rva23u64'
stderr '-D GORISCV64EXT_zacas'
stderr '-D GORISCV64EXT_misaligned_fast'

# Extensions are matched case-insensitively and emitted in lower case.
env GORISCV64=rva22u64,ZaBhA
go build -x .
stderr '-D GORISCV64_rva22u64'
stderr '-D GORISCV64EXT_zabha'

-- go.mod --
module m

-- p.go --
package p

func F()

-- p_riscv64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT ·F(SB), NOSPLIT, $0-0
	RET
